title: NocturneSlayer
description: NocturneSlayer is a Minecraft plugin that adds immersive combat mechanics, progression systems, and dark fantasy gameplay elements.
body:
NocturneSlayer — Glory Kills, Souls, Fury & Slayer HUD

NocturneSlayer transforms vanilla combat into a fast, aggressive, and skill-based experience inspired by modern action combat systems.

This plugin introduces Glory Kills, Soul progression, Fury stacks, and a dynamic HUD, turning every fight into a risk–reward decision.

Designed for survival servers that want more intensity without breaking vanilla balance.

🔥 Core Features

⚔️ Glory Kill System

Enemies can enter a DOWNED state instead of dying instantly.

Perform a Glory Kill to execute them and gain powerful bonuses.

Enemies glow and freeze briefly while vulnerable.

Configurable timing and cooldowns.

🩸 Souls System

Killing enemies grants Souls.

Souls increase your Slayer level.

Higher levels unlock stronger progression.

Nether enemies grant bonus souls.

🔥 Fury System

Glory Kills build Fury stacks.

Fury enhances combat potential.

Encourages aggressive and fast-paced gameplay.

❤️ Instant Heal & Combat Feedback

Glory Kills restore health.

Visual and sound feedback for every execution.

Particle effects and sound cues enhance immersion.

🧠 Smart Difficulty Scaling

Mobs feel tougher without becoming unfair.

Combat rewards positioning, timing, and decision-making.

🧩 Lightweight & Modular

No client mods required.

Fully server-side (Paper).

Configurable through config.yml.

⚙️ Commands
/slayer toggle


Enables or disables the system for the player.

🧾 Permissions
nocturneslayer.use


Allows a player to use the Slayer system.
